name: sentinel
description: SENTINEL — personal Security Command Center for Xiaomi cameras (via go2rtc)

scripts.setup: npm install && node scripts/install-go2rtc.mjs && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
